newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak FinMin, Bankers Trust to sign loan guarantee.
newsitem.headline: Slovak FinMin, Bankers Trust to sign loan guarantee.

text.p: The Slovak Finance Ministry on Wednesday said it would sign a guarantee for a $200 million loan with Bankers Trust Luxembourg in the first half of December.
The loan, a 10-year fiduciary with an interest of LIBOR plus 100-125 basis points to be lead managed by JP Morgan, is for state-owned construction firm Vodohospodarska Vystavba a.s. (VHV).

"In the first half of December we shall sign an agreement on guarantees and compensation of the loan with fiduciary bank Bankers Trust Luxembourg," Finance Ministry Spokeswoman Zuzana Brutenicova told Reuters.
The Slovak government in September agreed to guarantee the loan for VHV to finance the completion of the Gabcikovo dam project and a new dam on the River Vah at Zilina, northern Slovakia.
Brutenicova said the finance ministry would now formally sign the guarantee for the government.
